name: @autobroker/harness
description: AutoBroker live-LLM harness — the runnable implementation of the harness-standard (runner CLI, case TOML, 6+1 anchor evaluator, verdict.json, Approver gate poller, isolation preflight, test_run_records daily export). Black-box-drives the SUT over HTTP/SSE; reads the product DB READ-ONLY through @autobroker/db (the only permitted S3 channel); NEVER writes the DB and NEVER calls a provider directly (the SUT owns every side effect). dependency-cruiser isolates this package from better-sqlite3/drizzle-orm/playwright/@ai-sdk — respect that wall.
